summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for local service businesses that need fast bookings, accurate quotes, and consistent customer replies. The page positions Super as a sharper alternative to chat‑only assistants by showing how a personal AI agent can operate real software, handle repetitive workflows, and reuse a computer‑use cache so everyday admin work gets faster and cheaper over time.
